name: BRISA Patong by Sansiri
shortDescription: BRISA Patong is a Sansiri condominium of 389 homes in three eight-storey buildings on about 4 rai in central Patong.
description: BRISA Patong is a Sansiri condominium of 389 homes in three eight-storey buildings on about 4 rai in central Patong. Homes are one- and two-bedroom units of roughly 30 to 71 sqm, with about 70 percent being one-bedroom units. Units are handed over furnished. Planned facilities include a pool, gym, sauna, cold plunge and a garden.
furniture: Furnished, handed over with six appliances
researchNotes: Identity clear (Sansiri). Official Sansiri page not found. Launch dates conflict: booking 25 Nov 2026 vs public grand opening 7 Dec 2026 (FazWaz). Completion not announced. Freehold assumed from search summary (condo); not read on an official page. No fees or payment plan found. Unit builtUp ranges given as strings in unitTypes. Only portal page was read directly; FazWaz and Kaohoon returned 403. Land ~4 rai from search summary. | Portal shows 3,899,999-7,275,000 THB (2 units listed); Thai news reports 3.9-13.9M THB range. Starting price consistent at about 3.9M.
